description: Once-counted attendance across both days of a trade fair; the first message never says which fair or the daily counts. DISTILL-CANARY-1a6e84f0

turns.prompt: Cranshaw Foods owes the show organiser a single attendance figure for the hall summary and the fair closes this week. How many people came?

It is our two days at the Rossdale fair: 96 badges were scanned on day one and 88 on day two, and 31 of the day-one visitors returned on day two as well. Count each visitor once. How many attended across the two days? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
